title: The first-time tour shows what the town does now
items: The tour (Guide › Take the tour) is ten quick steps. New: Interact, where you walk up to someone, a horse or a boat and press R (or tap Interact) to talk, ride or take the helm; and Jaunts, the narrated stories told for your grade.

Look and Walk say how on your device, including Shift or a full push of the thumb to run. Settings names the name cards. A row of segments on the tour card fills as you go, and the card flashes as each step is passed.
The teachers' handout prints the ten steps.
